name: positioning-angles
description: Find the angle that makes something sell. Use this skill whenever the user mentions positioning, angles, differentiation, unique selling proposition, 'how do I stand out', 'what makes us different', value proposition, messaging framework, or 'find the hook'. Also trigger when copy isn't converting (often a positioning problem), when marketing feels generic, when launching a product, creating a lead magnet, writing a landing page, or entering a crowded market. Even if the user is about to write copy without established positioning, run this first — the angle informs everything downstream. Generates 3-5 positioning angles with competitive web research and validation.
